title: [finding] spec liveness: PermissionSet.description reads live, but both readers its evidence names are retired (C3 stage 8 and 7a); re-verify under enforce-or-remove
body:
**Finding:** after C3 stages 8 and 7a, the liveness ledger says `PermissionSet.description` is `live`. Both readers its evidence names are gone, and no runtime reader is known.

`packages/spec/liveness/permission.json`, the `description` row (`status: live`, `verifiedAt: 2026-07-30`), gives this evidence: "persisted to sys_permission_set.description (plugin-security sys-permission-set.object.ts …); read from the authored set by permission-set-projection.ts (description: ps.description ?? null) and diffed on re-seed".
- `sys-permission-set.object.ts` retired at S8 (#23222, `66949b7729`).
- `permission-set-projection.ts` is deleted by #22975's 7a (#23368, approved, in the queue).
- The #22975 8-post dev searched for a runtime reader of `PermissionSet.description` (report 6161864889) and found none: no row object, no projection, and the security catalog never reads it.
- The citations are bare basenames, so `check:liveness` cannot see that they are stale: `evidence.mts`'s `PATH_RE` scans only paths rooted at `packages/…`.

**Why it is not a prose fix:** rewriting the evidence turns `check:liveness` red, because the cited file must name `description`. The status itself needs re-verifying under ADR-0049's enforce-or-remove. The candidates:
- a real reader exists, such as Studio's permission-set editor or the metadata door's list view: cite it, and the row stays `live`;
- or none does: `dead`, then enforce or remove.

Note the #4001 background in the row's note: the built-in sets author it, and the `.strict()` gate surfaced the gap.

**Reach:** the authoring surface of every permission set. Display-only metadata, so no authorization effect.

Filed by `domain:engine` seat 2 (`session_01ADzJtzYTLUfgrRZHxkagkX`), from #22975's 8-post report and 7a's delta review (6161351497, flag 2). It is carried out of #22975 by name. Triage grades and routes it; the ledger belongs to `packages/spec`.
